Plan: IntakeText captures the brief, IntakeVideoAgent registers the town-hall, VideoAnalysisAgent parses the voting beats, HighlightAgent assembles the reel, TranscriptionAgent transcribes the votes and statements, SubtitleAgent generates English captions, CompositorAgent renders. No StoryAgent / ScreenplayAgent / KeyFrameAgent / VideoAgent because no new narrative is being generated. No IntakeImageAgent or BriefEnricherAgent because no reference image was provided. No VideoExtendAgent / StyleTransferAgent because only highlighting was requested. No MusicAgent / AmbienceAgent / AudioMixAgent because the town-hall's original audio is kept untouched. No TranslationAgent because the source and caption languages match.

plan.intent: Capture the two-minute city-council policy reel brief
Register the uploaded town-hall recording
Analyze the town-hall for decisive votes and statements
Select and assemble the critical findings into a two-minute reel
Transcribe the votes and key statements
Generate synced English captions with speaker tags
Composite the reel with the captions as the final deliverable
